summaryZh: Manor 实验室研究细胞骨架与细胞器动态的相互作用，及其在听力损失和神经退行中的影响。团队开发和应用显微相关计算与分子工具，结合深度学习图像分析、遗传与病毒工具、患者来源干细胞、转基因动物及电生理和行为检测。
researchQuestions: 细胞与组织如何动态组织，并在健康和疾病状态下随时间维持稳态？

evidence.quote: We focus on illuminating the interaction of cytoskeleton and organelle dynamics in hearing loss and neurodegeneration, supercharged by deep learning based image analysis methods.

To do this we develop and utilize genetic and viral tools, deep learning-based computational methods, patient-derived stem cell technology, transgenic animal models, and electrophysiological and behavioral assays.
We use a multidisciplinary approach to determine how cells and tissues dynamically organize and maintain homeostasis over time in health and disease.
